homonyms.basis: The census row carries no disambiguation field. No card is a homonym: every card concerns the project. 'Data Worker's Inquiry' (the press release, Bot Populi) and 'Data Workers Inquiry' (the Weizenbaum page, DAIR, SUPERRR) are spellings of the entity; 'DWI' is its acronym and is also the common abbreviation for driving while intoxicated, a homonym of the acronym only, not of the name. The distinct entities below are named by the field or the census beside the project and are never senses of its name.

captures.description: THE DATA WORKERS' INQUIRY, BY NAME, ON GOOGLE'S AI OVERVIEW, SIGNED OUT, 2026-10-29: 'a global, participatory research initiative that empowers data labelers, content moderators, and digital platform workers to investigate and document the hidden, precarious labor behind artificial intelligence.' Method (Workers' Inquiry as a Research Methodology, after Marx's 1880 Workers' Inquiry), epistemic authority with the workers, the outputs (zines, documentaries, comics), the countries, the conditions documented (low pay, the Remotasks shutdown in Kenya, trauma, NDAs, rejections, data extraction), the partners and the unions. Eleven cards, the project's own site and DAIR's and Weizenbaum's pages among them.
